concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: a polished logo exploration board for CYMBA, a premium audio and neurotechnology company.
Primary request: a distinctly techy, clean, modern technology brand identity. Create a compact abstract C-shaped signal symbol built from three thick horizontal geometric bands with carefully cut stepped ends and precise negative spaces. It should suggest sampled signals and fast digital communication, but retain a clear, robust silhouette. Make this an original graphic composition, not an ordinary font C or stock equalizer. Pair it with the exact wordmark "CYMBA" in a crisp medium-weight extended technical grotesk, subtle squared corners and excellent optical kerning. This is precise consumer hardware branding.
Composition: landscape board on uniform cool off-white #f5f5f7. One large centered horizontal symbol-plus-wordmark lockup in charcoal #1d1d1f. Along the lower quarter, show the exact same icon small, then the exact same complete logo reversed in off-white on a small charcoal rectangle. Generous whitespace. Keep the design identical in every repeated instance.
Style: flat vector-like logo, very sharp edges, disciplined grid, high-end industrial technology identity. Confident and recognizably technical.
Text: "CYMBA" only. No other text, headings, captions or labels.
Avoid: circular segmented ring from earlier concepts, soft organic blobs, literal ears, brains, medical crosses, ECG spikes, stock wifi, infinity marks, microchip clip art, excessive detail, gradients, glows, shadows, 3D, texture, stationery mockups.

Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: a polished logo exploration board for CYMBA, a premium audio and neurotechnology company.
Primary request: a clean, strikingly techy CYMBA identity centered on an angular monogram. Design a compact C built from three connected solid geometric facets with 45-degree cuts and a single clean opening, conveying precision hardware and engineered motion. The mark should feel forward-moving and structural, with bold negative space and a distinctive silhouette. Avoid a regular hexagon outline or a generic chevron. Use a compact horizontal proportion, not a tall shield. Pair the mark with exact uppercase "CYMBA", a refined technical sans serif with softly squared bowls, medium weight, slightly extended proportions, carefully kerned. Technical and confident without looking like an esports team.
Composition: landscape board, uniform cool off-white #f5f5f7, centered large horizontal logo in charcoal #1d1d1f. Bottom quarter: the exact same standalone symbol small, and the exact same full logo in off-white on a small charcoal rectangle. Generous margins and whitespace, consistent geometry in every instance.
Style: flat vector-like identity design, crisp solid fills, precision industrial geometry. Suitable for engraving on tiny audio hardware.
Text (verbatim): "CYMBA" only; no captions, headings, slogans or extra text.
Avoid: circular rings, organic waves, clip-art microchips, racing stripes, shield logos, medical icons, circuit-board decoration, gradients, glow, 3D, shadows, textures, mockup objects.

Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: a polished tech logo exploration board for CYMBA, a premium audio and neurotechnology company.
Primary request: develop a genuinely distinct clean technical identity using a minimal interface-inspired symbol. Create an open rounded-square bracket shape suggesting a C, with a separate solid square signal element positioned in the opening. Use just two bold elements, mathematically balanced negative space, squared geometry with small precise corner radii. The symbol evokes a connection port, a device interface or information entering a system. Make it memorable and compact enough for a 16px favicon. Pair it with exact uppercase "CYMBA" in a medium-weight subtly monospaced technical sans-serif with beautiful custom spacing, readable and premium. The typography should feel like precision instrumentation made into a consumer brand.
Composition: landscape white-cool-grey #f5f5f7 presentation. One large centered horizontal logo, all charcoal #1d1d1f. At the bottom show the exact same small icon alone and the exact same full lockup reversed in off-white on a small charcoal panel. Generous whitespace. Exact consistency between repetitions.
Style: entirely flat vector-like branding with sharp edges, modern technical confidence and restraint.
Text (verbatim): "CYMBA" only. No explanations, slogans, labels or headings.
Avoid: orbital circles, organic blobs, infinity symbols, stock wifi, brackets surrounding the entire company name, literal computer screens, decorative circuits, gradients, neon glow, shadows, 3D, textures, stationery.

Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: a polished custom tech wordmark exploration board for CYMBA, a premium audio and neurotechnology company.
Primary request: design an unmistakably technical but sophisticated custom uppercase "CYMBA" wordmark. No separate symbol. Build the five letters from a coherent modular geometry with medium-bold strokes, extended proportions, squared bowls with precisely chamfered corners and one or two controlled stencil-like interruptions. Make the A beautifully distinctive through an open triangular counter or detached crossbar. The C, Y, M, B, A must all remain immediately readable. The family resemblance between the letters is crucial. Premium precision hardware and futuristic instrumentation, not decorative gaming typography. Wordmark should be confident, compact enough for a website header and memorable enough for hardware engraving.
Composition: landscape presentation on uniform cool off-white #f5f5f7. One large centered charcoal #1d1d1f wordmark. At the bottom show the exact same wordmark at smaller scale and the exact same wordmark reversed in off-white on a modest charcoal rectangle. Generous whitespace. Absolutely consistent letter geometry in all instances.
Style: flat vector-like custom typographic logo, very sharp edges, disciplined geometric grid, strong visual rhythm.
Text (verbatim): "CYMBA" only. No headings, captions, labels or other text.
Avoid: generic unmodified font, separate symbol, overly rounded friendly letters, illegible abstractions, many disconnected tiny fragments, sci-fi movie imitation, italic racing font, gradients, glow, 3D, shadows, textures or product mockups.
